```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
```

Check of CAMS-REG road traffic (Hohenberger et al. 2026, Earth Syst. Sci. Data 18, 3959 to 3978,
doi 10.5194/essd-18-3959-2026; data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15688722) as a traffic source for both cities.
Instruction: `mcda/Traffic_instructions.Rmd` (24 November 2026). Rules: `mcda/MCDA_paper_results_spec.md`.
Nothing is normalised and no score is changed or rerun.

```{r libs}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
source(here::here("R/theme_lancet.R"))

CRS_M <- 3035
# Archive root = parent of the folder that data/ links to (../ggn_analysis_archive), not in git
ARCHIVE  <- dirname(normalizePath(here::here("data")))
CAMS_DIR <- file.path(ARCHIVE, "cams_reg")
GPKG     <- file.path(CAMS_DIR, "spatial_distribution_transport_cams_reg_v8.1_files", "em_vkm_vector_dataset_4326.gpkg")
README   <- file.path(CAMS_DIR, "spatial_distribution_transport_cams_reg_v8.1_files", "Readme.txt")
OUT_DIR  <- here::here("output/figures_mcda/traffic_cams_reg_check")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

knitting <- function() isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))
ktab <- function(x, caption, digits = 3) {
  x <- x %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(., digits)))
  if (!knitting()) { cat("\n", caption, "\n", sep = ""); print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE); return(invisible(x)) }
  x %>% kable(caption = caption) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
}
skew <- function(x) e1071::skewness(x[!is.na(x)], type = 2)
top_q <- function(p) { q <- rep(NA_integer_, length(p)); q[!is.na(p)] <- ntile(p[!is.na(p)], 5); q }
```

# Step 1. Coverage

```{r step1-areas}
malta_grid <- readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds")) %>%
  transmute(gid = as.character(gid), NAME, Total_Population, ua_not_eligible, scored, new_trafficvol, norm_traffic)
klag_grid <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds")) %>%
  transmute(ID, popdense_2020 = if ("popdense_2020" %in% names(.)) popdense_2020 else NA_real_, scored,
            new_trafficvol, norm_traffic_cat)
stopifnot(nrow(malta_grid) == 10657, n_distinct(malta_grid$gid) == 10657,
          nrow(klag_grid) == 12418, n_distinct(klag_grid$ID) == 12418)
areas <- list(
  Malta      = st_sf(geometry = readRDS(here::here("data/malta/malta_union_boundary.rds")), crs = CRS_M),
  Klagenfurt = readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_boundary.rds")) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
                 st_union() %>% st_sf(geometry = .))
areas <- lapply(areas, function(a) st_sf(geometry = st_union(st_geometry(a))))
osm_files <- c(Malta = "data/malta/accessibility_malta/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg",
               Klagenfurt = "data/klagenfurt/accessibility_klagenfurt/own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg")
```

```{r step1-read}
# Spatial filter: bounding box of the study area plus 500 m, read through the gpkg spatial index.
# Clipped extracts cached in the archive.
read_cams <- function(city) {
  cache <- file.path(CAMS_DIR, paste0("cams_reg_", tolower(city), ".gpkg"))
  if (!file.exists(cache)) {
    bb <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(st_buffer(areas[[city]], 500))) %>% st_transform(4326)
    x <- st_read(GPKG, layer = LAYER, wkt_filter = st_as_text(bb), quiet = TRUE)
    st_write(x, cache, quiet = TRUE)
  }
  x <- st_read(cache, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M)
  x <- x[st_intersects(x, st_buffer(areas[[city]], 500), sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]
  x %>% mutate(len_km = as.numeric(st_length(.)) / 1000)
}
cams <- lapply(c(Malta = "Malta", Klagenfurt = "Klagenfurt"), read_cams)
names(cams[[1]])
for (cn in names(cams)) {
  cat("\n", cn, ": links", nrow(cams[[cn]]), "\n")
  print(summary(cams[[cn]]$trafficvol_final))
}
```

```{r step1-coverage}
cov_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, ISO3_CODE, highway) %>% summarise(links = n(), km = sum(len_km), .groups = "drop"))) %>%
  arrange(city, desc(km))
ktab(cov_tab, "1. CAMS-REG links in each study area (500 m margin) by country and OSM class", 1)
ktab(cov_tab %>% group_by(city, ISO3_CODE) %>% summarise(links = sum(links), km = sum(km), .groups = "drop"),
     "1. By country", 1)
stopifnot(any(cams$Malta$ISO3_CODE %in% c("MLT", "MT")), any(cams$Klagenfurt$ISO3_CODE %in% c("AUT", "AT")))
```

## Traffic source of each link

`osm_otm` and `osm_otm_motorway`: random forest with OpenTransportMap attributes (links that matched
OpenTransportMap); `osm_only` and `osm_only_motorway`: random forest without OpenTransportMap; `smallroads_4`,
`smallroads_5`: spatial gap filling (30% and 15% of the mean tertiary AADT in 5 x 5 km cells). Definitions
from Readme.txt and the paper.

```{r step1-source}
src_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, source = trafficvol_final_source) %>% summarise(links = n(), km = sum(len_km), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(links_pct = 100 * links / sum(links), km_pct = 100 * km / sum(km))))
ktab(src_tab, "1. Traffic source, share of links and of road length", 1)
src_class <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, highway, source = trafficvol_final_source) %>% summarise(km = sum(len_km), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(city, highway) %>% mutate(km_pct = 100 * km / sum(km)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(-km) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = km_pct, values_fill = 0)))
ktab(src_class, "1. Traffic source by class, % of the class length", 1)
otm_malta <- src_tab %>% filter(city == "Malta", grepl("otm", source)) %>% summarise(km = sum(km), links = sum(links))
cat("Malta links with OpenTransportMap attributes:", otm_malta$links, "(", round(otm_malta$km, 1), "km )\n")
```

## Geometry: CAMS-REG vs our OSM extract

Drivable classes = spec 3.6 classes plus motorway (and links). Our extract: the walking network extract
(`own_routing/osm_highways_raw.gpkg`, November 2026). A road counts as missing where no CAMS-REG link is
within 10 m (pieces of at most 20 m).

```{r step1-geometry, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
DRIVE <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "unclassified", "residential",
           "living_street", "pedestrian", paste0(c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary"), "_link"))
osm <- lapply(names(osm_files), function(cn) {
  st_read(here::here(osm_files[[cn]]), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
    filter(highway %in% DRIVE) %>% st_intersection(st_geometry(st_buffer(areas[[cn]], 500))) %>%
    st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>% mutate(len_km = as.numeric(st_length(.)) / 1000)
}) %>% setNames(names(osm_files))
km_cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) full_join(
  st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>% group_by(highway) %>% summarise(cams_km = sum(len_km)),
  st_drop_geometry(osm[[cn]]) %>% group_by(highway) %>% summarise(osm_km = sum(len_km)), by = "highway") %>%
  mutate(city = cn, .before = 1))) %>% mutate(across(c(cams_km, osm_km), ~ coalesce(., 0))) %>% arrange(city, desc(osm_km))
ktab(km_cmp, "1. km by class: CAMS-REG vs our OSM extract", 1)

missing <- lapply(names(cams), function(cn) {
  pcs <- st_segmentize(osm[[cn]], 20) %>% st_cast("LINESTRING", warn = FALSE)
  pcs <- suppressWarnings(st_cast(st_cast(pcs, "MULTIPOINT"), "POINT"))  # vertices every <= 20 m
  # rebuild 20 m pieces from consecutive vertices of each way
  pcs <- pcs %>% group_by(osm_id, highway) %>% mutate(i = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
  xy <- st_coordinates(pcs)
  nxt <- c(seq_len(nrow(pcs))[-1], NA)
  ok <- !is.na(nxt) & c(pcs$osm_id[-1], NA) == pcs$osm_id & c(pcs$i[-1], NA) == pcs$i + 1
  segs <- st_sfc(lapply(which(ok), function(k) st_linestring(rbind(xy[k, 1:2], xy[nxt[k], 1:2]))), crs = CRS_M)
  segs <- st_sf(highway = pcs$highway[ok], geometry = segs) %>% mutate(len_km = as.numeric(st_length(.)) / 1000)
  near <- lengths(st_is_within_distance(segs, cams[[cn]], 10)) > 0
  segs %>% mutate(missing = !near, city = cn)
}) %>% setNames(names(cams))
miss_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(missing, st_drop_geometry)) %>% group_by(city, highway) %>%
  summarise(osm_km = sum(len_km), missing_km = sum(len_km[missing]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = 100 * missing_km / osm_km) %>% arrange(city, desc(missing_km))
ktab(miss_tab, "1. Our OSM drivable roads with no CAMS-REG link within 10 m", 1)
ktab(miss_tab %>% group_by(city) %>% summarise(osm_km = sum(osm_km), missing_km = sum(missing_km)) %>%
       mutate(missing_pct = 100 * missing_km / osm_km), "1. Missing, total", 1)

p_miss <- lapply(names(missing), function(cn) ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = areas[[cn]], fill = "grey97", colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cams[[cn]], colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = filter(missing[[cn]], missing), colour = "#d7301f", linewidth = 0.35) +
  lancet_scale_bar("bl") + labs(tag = cn) + theme_lancet_map())
p_m <- wrap_plots(p_miss, ncol = 2)
p_m
save_figure_lancet(p_m, "missing_roads_cams", OUT_DIR, height_mm = 100, width_mm = 180)
```

Grey: CAMS-REG links; red: our OSM drivable roads with no CAMS-REG link within 10 m.

# Step 2. Plausibility

```{r step2-dist}
dist_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, highway) %>%
  summarise(links = n(), km = sum(len_km), aadt_median = median(trafficvol_final),
            aadt_p10 = quantile(trafficvol_final, 0.1), aadt_p90 = quantile(trafficvol_final, 0.9),
            at_minimum_pct = 100 * mean(trafficvol_final %in% c(15, 8)), .groups = "drop"))) %>%
  arrange(city, desc(aadt_median))
ktab(dist_tab, "2. AADT by class (vehicles per day); minimum = 15 or 8", 1)
```

## Malta: Regional Road

Reference: about 57,000 vehicles per day, annual average daily traffic on Regional Road in 2019, as reported
by AIS Environment ("Beyond the traffic: what Malta's roads reveal about growth"); not a Transport Malta
publication, and a road wide figure, not a count at a stated point. No public count was found for the
Kappara and Marsa junction roads.

```{r step2-malta}
osm_names_m <- st_read(here::here(osm_files[["Malta"]]), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(osm_id = as.numeric(osm_id), name)
rr <- cams$Malta %>% mutate(osm_id = as.numeric(osm_id)) %>% left_join(osm_names_m, by = "osm_id") %>%
  filter(grepl("Reġjonali|Regjonali|Regional Road", name, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat("Regional Road links matched by OSM name:", nrow(rr), "| km:", round(sum(rr$len_km), 2), "\n")
print(table(rr$name, rr$highway))
rr_tab <- st_drop_geometry(rr) %>%
  summarise(links = n(), km = sum(len_km),
            aadt_length_weighted_median = matrixStats::weightedMedian(trafficvol_final, len_km),
            aadt_min = min(trafficvol_final), aadt_max = max(trafficvol_final)) %>%
  mutate(official_2019 = 57000, ratio_median = aadt_length_weighted_median / official_2019)
ktab(rr_tab, "2. Malta Regional Road: CAMS-REG AADT vs about 57,000 vehicles per day (2019)", 2)
ggplot() + geom_sf(data = areas$Malta, fill = "grey97", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_sf(data = cams$Malta, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = rr, aes(colour = trafficvol_final), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "CAMS-REG AADT") + theme_lancet_map()
```

## Klagenfurt: Carinthia counting stations

Source: Land Kärnten, Abteilung 9, "Verkehrsdaten 2019 Landesstraßen B" (strassenbau.ktn.gv.at, Verkehrszählung),
JDTV 2019 (all motor vehicles, both directions). Stations are listed by road and section name, without
coordinates. Stations named after a cross street are placed at the intersection of the road (OSM `ref`,
Overpass extract cached in the archive) with the street of that name in our OSM extract; stations named after
places or landmarks are not placed. Several sections carry the same JDTV (one counter assigned to neighbouring
sections). No ASFINAG station level data for the A2 in the study area were found online.

```{r step2-stations}
stations <- tribble(
  ~ref,  ~station,                 ~jdtv_2019,
  "B70",  "Schachterlweg",          21850,
  "B70",  "Ramsauerstraße",         19574,
  "B70",  "Rosenbergstraße",        19574,
  "B70",  "Enzenbergerstraße",      21531,
  "B70c", "Mießtalerstraße",        20812,
  "B70c", "Lastenstraße",           20812,
  "B70c", "Bahnhofstraße",          15610,
  "B70c", "10. Oktober Straße",     13975,
  "B70c", "Rosentaler Straße",      13944,
  "B70c", "Waidmannsdorfer Straße", 14386,
  "B70c", "Koschatstraße",          18679,
  "B70d", "Ebenthaler Straße",      18250,
  "B70d", "Gerberweg",              19389,
  "B70d", "Kirchengasse",           18018,
  "B70d", "St. Ruprechter Str.",    16940,
  "B70d", "Flatschacher Straße",    17251,
  "B70d", "Rosentaler Straße",      20670,
  "B70d", "Waidmannsdorfer Straße", 13538,
  "B70d", "Siebenhügelstraße",      12165,
  "B70d", "Süduferstraße",          10308,
  "B83",  "Waltendorfer Straße",    17690,
  "B83",  "Deutenhofenstraße",      21018,
  "B83",  "Radetzkystraße",         18398,
  "B83",  "Koschatstraße",          23351,
  "B91",  "Villacher Ring",         25876,
  "B91",  "Maximilianstraße",       27460,
  "B91",  "Hirschenwirtstraße",     25665,
  "B91",  "Südring",                28517)

norm_name <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x); x <- gsub("ß", "ss", x); x <- gsub("str\\.?$", "strasse", x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-zäöü0-9]", "", x); x
}
# OSM ways with a ref tag (motorway to tertiary), Overpass extract of 24 November 2026, cached in the archive
ov <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(CAMS_DIR, "klagenfurt_osm_ref_ways.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)$elements
tag <- function(e, k) if (is.null(e$tags[[k]])) NA_character_ else e$tags[[k]]
ref_ways <- st_sf(
  osm_id = sapply(ov, function(e) e$id), ref = sapply(ov, tag, "ref"), name = sapply(ov, tag, "name"),
  highway = sapply(ov, tag, "highway"), oneway = sapply(ov, tag, "oneway"),
  geometry = st_sfc(lapply(ov, function(e) st_linestring(do.call(rbind, lapply(e$geometry, function(g) c(g$lon, g$lat))))),
                    crs = 4326)) %>%
  st_transform(CRS_M) %>% mutate(ref_n = gsub("\\s", "", ref))
cat("OSM ways with ref:", nrow(ref_ways), "\n"); print(table(ref_ways$ref_n))
osm_k <- st_read(here::here(osm_files[["Klagenfurt"]]), quiet = TRUE) %>% st_transform(CRS_M) %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)) %>% mutate(name_n = norm_name(name))
cams_k <- cams$Klagenfurt %>% mutate(osm_id = as.numeric(osm_id))

locate <- function(rf, station) {
  road <- ref_ways[sapply(strsplit(ref_ways$ref_n, ";"), function(r) rf %in% r), ]
  cross <- osm_k %>% filter(name_n == norm_name(station))
  if (nrow(road) == 0 || nrow(cross) == 0) return(NULL)
  ix <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(st_union(road), st_union(cross)))
  if (length(ix) == 0 || st_is_empty(ix)) {
    # cross street ends near the road (T junction): nearest point within 15 m
    d <- st_distance(st_union(road), st_union(cross))
    if (as.numeric(d) > 15) return(NULL)
    ix <- st_cast(st_nearest_points(st_union(cross), st_union(road)), "POINT")[2]
  }
  pt <- st_centroid(st_union(st_cast(ix, "POINT")))
  # CAMS-REG links of the same road (OSM way id) within 30 m; dual carriageway: one way per direction,
  # so the AADT of the two directions is summed (each direction's maximum)
  ids <- as.numeric(road$osm_id)
  near <- cams_k[cams_k$osm_id %in% ids & lengths(st_is_within_distance(cams_k, pt, 30)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(near) == 0) return(st_sf(ref = rf, station = station, cams_aadt = NA_real_, cams_aadt_any_main = NA_real_,
                                    cams_links = 0L, oneway = NA, geometry = pt))
  ow <- road$oneway[match(near$osm_id, as.numeric(road$osm_id))] %in% c("yes", "-1", "true", "1")
  val <- if (all(ow)) {
    # group links by bearing (direction of travel), max per direction, sum
    bear <- sapply(st_geometry(near), function(g) { xy <- st_coordinates(g); atan2(xy[nrow(xy), 2] - xy[1, 2], xy[nrow(xy), 1] - xy[1, 1]) })
    dir <- cos(bear - bear[which.max(near$trafficvol_final)]) > 0
    sum(tapply(near$trafficvol_final, dir, max))
  } else max(near$trafficvol_final)
  # Robustness: highest AADT of any main road link within 30 m, without matching the road
  any_main <- cams_k[cams_k$highway %in% c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary") &
                     lengths(st_is_within_distance(cams_k, pt, 30)) > 0, ]
  st_sf(ref = rf, station = station, cams_aadt = val, cams_aadt_any_main = max(c(NA, any_main$trafficvol_final), na.rm = TRUE),
        cams_links = nrow(near), oneway = all(ow), geometry = pt)
}
pts <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), Map(locate, stations$ref, stations$station))) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = c("ref", "station"))
cat("Stations placed:", nrow(pts), "of", nrow(stations), "| with a CAMS-REG value:", sum(!is.na(pts$cams_aadt)), "\n")
setdiff(paste(stations$ref, stations$station), paste(pts$ref, pts$station))
pt_tab <- st_drop_geometry(pts) %>% mutate(ratio = cams_aadt / jdtv_2019) %>%
  select(ref, station, official_jdtv_2019 = jdtv_2019, cams_aadt, ratio, cams_aadt_any_main, cams_links, oneway)
ktab(pt_tab, "2. Klagenfurt: official JDTV 2019 vs CAMS-REG AADT", 2)
ok <- !is.na(pt_tab$cams_aadt)
sp_all <- cor(pt_tab$official_jdtv_2019[ok], pt_tab$cams_aadt[ok], method = "spearman")
# distinct counts only (sections that share one counter value counted once)
dd <- pt_tab[ok, ] %>% group_by(ref, official_jdtv_2019) %>% summarise(cams_aadt = median(cams_aadt), .groups = "drop")
sp_dist <- cor(dd$official_jdtv_2019, dd$cams_aadt, method = "spearman")
sp_any <- cor(pt_tab$official_jdtv_2019[ok], pt_tab$cams_aadt_any_main[ok], method = "spearman")
ktab(tibble(set = c("All placed stations", "Distinct JDTV values per road", "All placed stations, highest main road link within 30 m"),
            points = c(sum(ok), nrow(dd), sum(ok)),
            spearman = c(sp_all, sp_dist, sp_any),
            median_ratio = c(median(pt_tab$ratio[ok]), median(dd$cams_aadt / dd$official_jdtv_2019),
                             median(pt_tab$cams_aadt_any_main[ok] / pt_tab$official_jdtv_2019[ok]))),
     "2. Klagenfurt: rank agreement across counting points", 3)
ggplot(pt_tab[ok, ], aes(official_jdtv_2019, cams_aadt, colour = ref)) + geom_point() +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") + labs(x = "Official JDTV 2019", y = "CAMS-REG AADT") + theme_lancet()
```

## Units check

Readme.txt: `trafficvol_final` = "Estimated AADT"; `road_length` in metres; `vkm_*` = "VKM per road segment
(thousands/day)". If `trafficvol_final` is vehicles per day for all vehicles on the link, then
`trafficvol_final x road_length / 1000` (vehicle km per day) equals `vkm_abs_sum_speed_based_urh x 1000`.
Ratios are computed on the full CAMS-REG links of each study area (500 m margin), before clipping to cells.

```{r units-vkm}
u_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  filter(road_length > 0, vkm_abs_sum_speed_based_urh > 0) %>%
  mutate(r_readme = (trafficvol_final * road_length / 1000) / (vkm_abs_sum_speed_based_urh * 1000),
         r_no_thousands = (trafficvol_final * road_length / 1000) / vkm_abs_sum_speed_based_urh) %>%
  group_by(city = cn, highway) %>%
  summarise(links = n(), median_ratio_x1000 = median(r_readme), min_ratio_x1000 = min(r_readme),
            max_ratio_x1000 = max(r_readme), median_ratio_no_x1000 = median(r_no_thousands),
            min_ratio_no_x1000 = min(r_no_thousands), max_ratio_no_x1000 = max(r_no_thousands), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(city, desc(links))))
ktab(u_tab, "Units. (trafficvol_final x road_length / 1000) / (vkm_abs_sum_speed_based_urh x 1000), by class; also without the x 1000", 4)
# road_length vs the geometry length (checks that road_length is the full link in metres)
ktab(bind_rows(lapply(names(cams), function(cn) st_drop_geometry(cams[[cn]]) %>%
  summarise(city = cn, median_road_length_over_geom = median(road_length / (len_km * 1000)),
            p01 = quantile(road_length / (len_km * 1000), 0.01), p99 = quantile(road_length / (len_km * 1000), 0.99)))),
  "Units. road_length / geometry length", 3)
```

Counting stations with CAMS-REG doubled on oneway links: a oneway link is taken to carry one direction, so its
AADT is doubled; where the links of both directions (both carriageways) are found at the station, the
direction maxima are summed and not doubled. Current criterion at the stations: `new_trafficvol` of the
Klagenfurt grid (OpenTransportMap, value of the 100 m cell that contains the station point; also the highest
value of the cells within 50 m).

```{r units-stations}
cams_dir_aadt <- function(rf, pt) {
  road <- ref_ways[sapply(strsplit(ref_ways$ref_n, ";"), function(r) rf %in% r), ]
  near <- cams_k[cams_k$osm_id %in% as.numeric(road$osm_id) & lengths(st_is_within_distance(cams_k, pt, 30)) > 0, ]
  if (nrow(near) == 0) return(tibble(cams_aadt_oneway2 = NA_real_, directions = NA_integer_))
  ow <- road$oneway[match(near$osm_id, as.numeric(road$osm_id))] %in% c("yes", "-1", "true", "1")
  if (all(ow)) {
    bear <- sapply(st_geometry(near), function(g) { xy <- st_coordinates(g); atan2(xy[nrow(xy), 2] - xy[1, 2], xy[nrow(xy), 1] - xy[1, 1]) })
    dir <- cos(bear - bear[which.max(near$trafficvol_final)]) > 0
    nd <- length(unique(dir))
    v <- if (nd == 2) sum(tapply(near$trafficvol_final, dir, max)) else 2 * max(near$trafficvol_final)
    tibble(cams_aadt_oneway2 = v, directions = nd)
  } else tibble(cams_aadt_oneway2 = max(near$trafficvol_final * ifelse(ow, 2, 1)), directions = NA_integer_)
}
st2 <- bind_cols(pt_tab, bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pts)), function(i) cams_dir_aadt(pts$ref[i], st_geometry(pts)[i]))))
kg <- klag_grid %>% select(new_trafficvol)
st2$otm_cell <- kg$new_trafficvol[sapply(st_intersects(pts, kg), function(i) if (length(i)) i[1] else NA)]
st2$otm_max50 <- sapply(st_is_within_distance(pts, kg, 50), function(i) max(kg$new_trafficvol[i]))
ktab(st2 %>% select(ref, station, official_jdtv_2019, oneway, directions, cams_aadt, cams_aadt_oneway2, otm_cell, otm_max50),
     "Units. Stations: CAMS-REG as used, CAMS-REG doubled on oneway links, current OpenTransportMap cell value", 2)
ok2 <- !is.na(st2$cams_aadt)
sp_row <- function(lab, x) tibble(set = lab, points = sum(ok2 & !is.na(x)),
  spearman = cor(st2$official_jdtv_2019[ok2], x[ok2], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
  median_ratio = median(x[ok2] / st2$official_jdtv_2019[ok2], na.rm = TRUE))
units_sp <- bind_rows(sp_row("CAMS-REG as in Step 2", st2$cams_aadt),
                      sp_row("CAMS-REG doubled on oneway links", st2$cams_aadt_oneway2),
                      sp_row("Current criterion new_trafficvol, station cell", st2$otm_cell),
                      sp_row("Current criterion new_trafficvol, max of cells within 50 m", st2$otm_max50))
ktab(units_sp, "Units. Klagenfurt counting stations: Spearman and median ratio to official JDTV 2019", 3)
```

# Step 3. Cell indicator

`traffic_vkm` = sum over links in the cell of AADT x length inside the cell (km) = vehicle km per day.
Main: all CAMS-REG classes except service and track. Sensitivity: all classes; main roads only. Cells with no
kept link: 0.

```{r step3-vkm}
MAIN_ROADS <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary",
                paste0(c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary"), "_link"))
grids <- list(Malta = malta_grid %>% select(cell = gid), Klagenfurt = klag_grid %>% select(cell = ID))
vkm_cells <- function(cn) {
  cache <- file.path(CAMS_DIR, paste0("cams_reg_vkm_pieces_", tolower(cn), ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(cache)) {
    p <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(cams[[cn]] %>% select(highway, trafficvol_final), grids[[cn]])) %>%
      st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>% mutate(km = as.numeric(st_length(.)) / 1000) %>% st_drop_geometry()
    saveRDS(p, cache)
  }
  p <- readRDS(cache)
  agg <- function(keep) p %>% filter(keep(highway)) %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(v = sum(trafficvol_final * km))
  out <- st_drop_geometry(grids[[cn]]) %>%
    left_join(agg(function(h) !h %in% c("service", "track")) %>% rename(traffic_vkm = v), by = "cell") %>%
    left_join(agg(function(h) rep(TRUE, length(h))) %>% rename(traffic_vkm_all = v), by = "cell") %>%
    left_join(agg(function(h) h %in% MAIN_ROADS) %>% rename(traffic_vkm_main = v), by = "cell") %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("traffic_vkm"), ~ coalesce(., 0)))
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == nrow(grids[[cn]]))
  out
}
vkm <- lapply(names(grids), vkm_cells) %>% setNames(names(grids))
stopifnot(nrow(vkm$Malta) == 10657, nrow(vkm$Klagenfurt) == 12418)
desc_vkm <- bind_rows(lapply(names(vkm), function(cn) bind_rows(lapply(c("traffic_vkm", "traffic_vkm_all", "traffic_vkm_main"), function(v) {
  x <- vkm[[cn]][[v]]; elig <- if (cn == "Malta") !malta_grid$ua_not_eligible else rep(TRUE, length(x)); x <- x[elig]
  tibble(city = cn, version = v, cells = length(x), zero_pct = 100 * mean(x == 0), median_above_0 = median(x[x > 0]),
         q25_above_0 = quantile(x[x > 0], 0.25), q75_above_0 = quantile(x[x > 0], 0.75), skewness = skew(x),
         skewness_log10_plus1 = skew(log10(x + 1)), p98 = quantile(x, 0.98))
}))))
ktab(desc_vkm, "3. traffic_vkm per cell (vehicle km per day), eligible cells", 2)
for (cn in names(vkm)) { cat("\n", cn, "\n"); print(summary(vkm[[cn]]$traffic_vkm)) }
h3 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(vkm), function(cn) tibble(city = cn, x = vkm[[cn]]$traffic_vkm)))
ggplot(filter(h3, x > 0), aes(x)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "grey40") + scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ city, scales = "free_y") + labs(x = "traffic_vkm, cells above 0 (log scale)", y = "Cells") + theme_lancet()
```

# Step 4. Comparison with the current criterion (OpenTransportMap)

Malta current indicator: `new_trafficvol`; Klagenfurt current traffic score: `norm_traffic_cat` (3 classes;
raw `new_trafficvol` also shown). Spearman and top quintile overlap (spec 5.1, 5.2) on eligible cells (Malta
airport and port excluded) and on cells above 0 in either.

```{r step4-compare}
cur <- list(Malta = malta_grid %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(cell = gid, elig = !ua_not_eligible,
                                                                    current = new_trafficvol, current_class = norm_traffic),
            Klagenfurt = klag_grid %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% transmute(cell = ID, elig = TRUE,
                                                                        current = norm_traffic_cat, current_raw = new_trafficvol,
                                                                        current_class = norm_traffic_cat))
cmp <- function(a, b, k) {
  qa <- top_q(ifelse(k, a, NA)); qb <- top_q(ifelse(k, b, NA))
  tibble(cells = sum(k), spearman = cor(a[k], b[k], method = "spearman"),
         top_quintile_overlap_pct = 100 * mean(qb[which(qa == 5)] == 5))
}
t4 <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cur), function(cn) {
  d <- cur[[cn]] %>% left_join(vkm[[cn]], by = "cell")
  e <- d$elig & !is.na(d$current)
  bind_rows(
    cmp(d$current, d$traffic_vkm, e) %>% mutate(set = "Eligible cells"),
    cmp(d$current, d$traffic_vkm, e & (d$current > 0 | d$traffic_vkm > 0)) %>% mutate(set = "Above 0 in either"),
    if (cn == "Klagenfurt") cmp(d$current_raw, d$traffic_vkm, e) %>% mutate(set = "Eligible cells, raw new_trafficvol") else NULL) %>%
    mutate(city = cn, .before = 1)
}))
ktab(t4, "4. Current criterion vs traffic_vkm (main version)", 3)

xt <- lapply(names(cur), function(cn) {
  d <- cur[[cn]] %>% left_join(vkm[[cn]], by = "cell") %>% filter(elig)
  table(current_class = d$current_class, traffic_vkm_quintile = top_q(d$traffic_vkm))
}) %>% setNames(names(cur))
xt

# Klagenfurt top class share with the Step 3 tie rule (>= p80, or > p80 if that class is above 25%)
topclass <- function(x) { q <- quantile(x, 0.8, na.rm = TRUE); t <- x >= q; if (mean(t, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.25) t <- x > q; t }
ks <- klag_grid$scored
ktab(tibble(indicator = c("Current (norm_traffic_cat)", "traffic_vkm"),
            top_class_pct_scored_cells = 100 * c(mean(topclass(klag_grid$norm_traffic_cat[ks])),
                                                 mean(topclass(vkm$Klagenfurt$traffic_vkm[ks])))),
     "4. Klagenfurt: share of scored cells in the top class (tie rule)", 1)
```

```{r step4-maps, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
lw_pt <- function(pt) pt / (ggplot2::.pt * 0.75)
ras <- function(g) {
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(g))); ox <- median(xy[, 1] %% 100); oy <- median(xy[, 2] %% 100)
  tibble(x = round((xy[, 1] - ox) / 100) * 100 + ox, y = round((xy[, 2] - oy) / 100) * 100 + oy)
}
map_city <- function(cn, grid) {
  d <- cur[[cn]] %>% left_join(vkm[[cn]], by = "cell")
  q_c <- top_q(ifelse(d$elig, d$current, NA)); q_v <- top_q(ifelse(d$elig, d$traffic_vkm, NA))
  df <- bind_cols(ras(grid), d) %>% mutate(change2 = !is.na(q_c) & abs(q_c - q_v) >= 2)
  b <- areas[[cn]]; bb <- st_bbox(b)
  mask <- st_sf(geometry = st_difference(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(st_buffer(b, 2000))), st_union(b)))
  base <- function(p, bar) p + geom_sf(data = mask, fill = "white", colour = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = b, fill = NA, colour = "grey25", linewidth = lw_pt(0.3)) +
    (if (bar) lancet_scale_bar("bl") else NULL) +
    coord_sf(xlim = bb[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bb[c("ymin", "ymax")], crs = CRS_M, datum = NA) +
    theme_lancet_map(base_size = 8) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  p1 <- base(ggplot() + geom_raster(data = filter(df, elig), aes(x, y, fill = factor(current_class))) +
               scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Purples", name = "Current traffic class") + labs(tag = paste(cn, "A")), TRUE)
  p2 <- base(ggplot() + geom_raster(data = filter(df, elig), aes(x, y, fill = traffic_vkm + 1)) +
               scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", option = "magma", direction = -1, name = "traffic_vkm + 1 (log scale)") +
               labs(tag = "B"), FALSE)
  p3 <- base(ggplot() + geom_raster(data = filter(df, elig), aes(x, y, fill = change2)) +
               scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey90", `TRUE` = "#d7301f"), name = "Quintile change >= 2") +
               labs(tag = "C"), FALSE)
  p1 + p2 + p3
}
m4 <- map_city("Malta", malta_grid) / map_city("Klagenfurt", klag_grid)
m4
save_figure_lancet(m4, "traffic_current_vs_cams", OUT_DIR, height_mm = 200, width_mm = 180)
```
